invoices.PR_TITLE: Video pipeline reliability — uploads finish without a babysitter

LINE_ITEMS.NAME: Post-upload status polling with backoff
LINE_ITEMS.SUMMARY: Replace the single post-upload sync call with a backoff poll (~2 min) that hands off to the Cloudflare Stream webhook. Removes the silent stall that leaves an uploaded episode permanently "processing".

LINE_ITEMS.NAME: Ingest state, failure reason and retry in the admin media list
LINE_ITEMS.SUMMARY: Surface per-asset ingest status (pending_upload / processing / ready / failed) with the Cloudflare failure reason and a retry control, so a stuck asset is visible instead of silent.

LINE_ITEMS.NAME: Human-readable playback errors
LINE_ITEMS.SUMMARY: Map the playback endpoint 409 codes (media still processing, no media asset, missing provider asset id) to distinct member-facing copy, replacing the single generic error box.

LINE_ITEMS.NAME: Stream configuration warning banner
LINE_ITEMS.SUMMARY: Render getStreamConfigStatus().missingKeys in the admin panel so an absent CLOUDFLARE_STREAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET or account/token is visible to an admin rather than failing silently in logs.

LINE_ITEMS.NAME: Post-upload publish prompt
LINE_ITEMS.SUMMARY: State the next required action after an upload completes — an uploaded episode is created hidden and needs an explicit publish before members can see it.

LINE_ITEMS.NAME: Test coverage for polling and error mapping
LINE_ITEMS.SUMMARY: Extend the uploads/sync server tests to cover the polling path and terminal states; add unit coverage for the playback error-code mapping.
